description:
Get list of all available tissues in the expression dataset.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table expression — one record = the baseline expression of one gene across tissues.
Key: id.
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Baseline expression (Expression Atlas, HPA) integrated by OT 25.09; a missing tissue means not measured.
